features.definition: The fictional PulseMeter's 8-bit count is initially 0; on each clk rising edge, increment by 1 if pulse=1, otherwise hold.
features.timing: pulse is driven on the clk falling edge and sampled on the rising edge; count is stable after the register update on that rising edge.
features.boundary: No reset port; the 8-bit unsigned count wraps around from 255 to 0.
